title: Tier Entry Requirements for Northgate Memberships
content:
Every tier of Northgate Memberships has an entry gate: a minimum age of the primary member and a proof, and on the two discounted tiers a verified status that must be kept up at renewal.

## Entry chart

| Tier | Minimum age of the primary member on the enrollment date | Proof | Third-party student verification at enrollment and every renewal | Third-party service verification at enrollment and every renewal | Business license, resale certificate or EIN letter in the business name at enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 18 years | third-party student verification | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 18 years | third-party service verification | No | Yes | No |
| Northgate Club Membership | 18 years | government photo ID | No | No | No |
| Northgate Business Membership | 18 years | business license, resale certificate or IRS EIN letter in the business name | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 18 years | government photo ID | No | No | No |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 18 years | business license, resale certificate or IRS EIN letter in the business name | No | No | Yes |

## Status-verified tiers

| Tier | Qualifying verified statuses | Months a successful verification stays valid | Tier the membership renews into when the verification is not valid on the first day of the new year | Maximum consecutive membership years at the tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | full-time student; half-time student (enrolled at least half-time at an accredited US college or university) | 12 calendar months | Northgate Club Membership | 4 |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | active duty; reservist or National Guard; veteran; military spouse; sworn first responder | 24 calendar months | Northgate Club Membership | no limit (0) |
| Northgate Club Membership | none required | no verification (0) | not applicable | no limit (0) |
| Northgate Business Membership | none required | no verification (0) | not applicable | no limit (0) |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | none required | no verification (0) | not applicable | no limit (0) |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | none required | no verification (0) | not applicable | no limit (0) |

A figure of 0 in the validity column means the tier uses no status verification; a figure of 0 in the last column means no limit on consecutive years.

## Points of judgement on the chart

- The minimum age is the same at every tier: 18 years on the enrollment date.
- Only the Student Club tier asks for student verification and only the Heroes Club tier asks for service verification; each asks for it at enrollment and at every renewal.
- Only the two business tiers ask for a business license, resale certificate or EIN letter in the business name, and only at enrollment.
- Only the Student Club tier limits the number of consecutive discounted years, to 4.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An applicant who turns 18 on the enrollment date meets the age entry for any tier; one who turns 18 the day after does not meet it on that enrollment date.
- A Heroes Club verification returned as successful stays valid for 24 calendar months; a Student Club verification for 12 calendar months.
